verdict.rationale: dlt's core docs directly address this story: schema inference/normalization of nested JSON into typed tables (dlt-docs-2, dlt-docs-20, dlt-docs-37), merge/dedupe via primary_key/merge_key (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-35), and querying resulting datasets via SQL/dataframes (dlt-docs-12, dlt-docs-28). One community comment even flags automatic schema migration as an 'anti-feature' they'd want to disable (dlt-comm-8), showing real-world awareness of the schema-evolution behavior rather than contradicting its existence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of dedup/typing correctness at scale and more third-party corroboration beyond one HN thread.
